rollback_evidence: 1.0.12 eos switchport admin (E05/E19), measured on cEOS 4.36.1F. Safeguard first: Admin commits an empty configuration session netops-<id> with 'commit timer HH:MM:SS' before the change, so its checkpoint is the configuration before the change; the change then runs line by line through 'configure terminal'. Confirmation is 'configure session netops-<id> commit' and 'no configure session netops-<id>'; write memory runs only after it. An expired timer returns the WHOLE running configuration to the checkpoint of the session, so a change of someone else made in the timer window is reverted too; only the log proves the revert (CONFIG_SESSION_COMMIT_TIMER_TIMEDOUT and CONFIG_SESSION_COMMIT_REVERTED). The write account must log in with privilege 15 (aaa authorization exec default local); the check account (privilege 1) reads the state. EOS keeps VLANs in the running configuration ('vlan N' with '   name NAME'), so the timed safeguard returns a created, renamed or deleted VLAN as well. Lines: 'vlan N' / 'name NAME' (one ASCII word; EOS cuts a name longer than 32 characters without an error, so Admin allows 1-32 characters), 'no name' for the default name VLANnnnn, 'no vlan N'. A VLAN in a list line, with lines other than name, with a routed interface VlanN, named by a port (access, native, phone VLAN or an explicit allowed list; the default allowed list all is no reference) or with learned MAC addresses is not deleted. The check account reads show vlan id N.
